content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Ogden

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no work experience necessary. This makes the credential ideal for Ogden professionals entering or transitioning into project management roles across aerospace, defense, manufacturing, and healthcare sectors. Verify your education meets PMI standards before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format covers all CAPM domains and is designed for working professionals in Ogden who need flexible scheduling. You'll learn from active certified practitioners and study real-world project scenarios relevant to your industry.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your education, create your PMI account and submit your CAPM application. You'll provide proof of your secondary degree and course completion. Pay the associated exam fee through PMI's secure portal to proceed to your certification exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources to help you review key concepts and practice test questions. Schedule your proctored CAPM exam through PMI and test at a center convenient to you. Our instructors remain available to clarify difficult topics before your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units by attending training, conferences, or volunteering on projects. Renew your credential by submitting your PDU total to PMI before expiration to stay certified and competitive.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
